evals.prompt: Send a welcome email to new users with the LetMeSend.Email Python SDK.
evals.expected_output: Uses from_/type_ kwargs, LetMeSendEmailError handling, context manager, and an idempotency key.
expectations: Passes an idempotency key on the send

evals.prompt: Our newsletter goes to 10,000 subscribers. Should I loop emails.send?
evals.expected_output: No - routes to the lmse-marketing skill and campaigns instead of looping transactional sends.
expectations: Does not recommend looping transactional sends

evals.prompt: How do I get notified when emails bounce?
evals.expected_output: Points to webhooks.md delivery events (bounced/complained) and list-hygiene follow-up.
